children: Analysts said U.S. consumers remained willing to spend ahead of the holiday shopping season, while inflation had not yet significantly dampened spending. According to Odaily, a Bloomberg survey found economists expect inflation-adjusted personal consumption expenditures to rise 0.1% month over month in October, following strong spending growth in each of the previous two quarters.

The PCE price index is expected to increase 3.8% year over year, nearly twice the Federal Reserve’s 2% inflation target. Core PCE, which excludes food and energy, is also expected to accelerate, bolstering market expectations of a Fed rate hike in December. Continued job growth and steady consumer and business activity give policymakers room to shift their focus toward inflation, while rising prices add to pressure on the Fed.

title: Analysts Expect U.S. October PCE Inflation to Reach 3.8%, Fed Rate-Hike Expectations to Rise
